fine_lines.title: It beats me vs it escapes me
fine_lines.explanation_ar: it beats me تعني: لا أعرف أو لا أفهم (لم أعرفه أصلاً). it escapes me تعني: نسيت، كنت أعرفه لكنني لا أتذكره الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'It beats me' = I don't know or understand it. 'It escapes me' = I knew it, but I can't remember it now.

examples.sentence: It beats me why he left so early.
I met her last year, but her name escapes me.

fine_lines.title: I don't buy it vs it beats me
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I don't buy it تعني: لا أصدّق ما تقوله. it beats me تعني: لا أعرف الجواب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'I don't buy it' = I don't believe what you say. 'It beats me' = I don't know the answer.

examples.sentence: You finished the book in one hour? I don't buy it.
How does this machine work? It beats me.

fine_lines.title: Excuse me vs sorry
fine_lines.explanation_ar: excuse me تُقال قبل أن تزعج أحداً (لجذب الانتباه، أو لتمرّ، أو لتسأل). sorry تُقال بعد أن تخطئ. وexcuse me? بنبرة صاعدة تعني: ماذا قلت؟ أو استغراب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say 'excuse me' before you disturb someone (to get attention, to pass, to ask). Say 'sorry' after you do something wrong. 'Excuse me?' with rising tone = what did you say? / surprise.

examples.sentence: Excuse me, is this seat free?
Sorry, I stepped on your foot.

expressions.phrase: it's the story of my life

expressions.example: It rained on my day off again - it's the story of my life.

expressions.meaning_en: please continue; don't let me disturb you
expressions.example: Don't mind me - I'm just getting my coat.

expressions.meaning_en: used to get attention, to pass someone, to say sorry for a small noise, or to show surprise
expressions.example: Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is?

expressions.meaning_en: to stop me from doing what I want or acting freely
expressions.example: Having to wear a uniform really cramps my style.

The name of that film escapes me right now.

expressions.meaning_en: I have none left of something
expressions.example: Can I have some sugar? - Sorry, I'm out.

grammar.title: Subject and object pronouns: I / me / my
grammar.explanation_ar: I ضمير فاعل يأتي قبل الفعل: I don't buy it. me ضمير مفعول يأتي بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر: it beats me، excuse me. my صفة ملكية تأتي قبل الاسم: my style، my life.
grammar.explanation_en: 'I' is the subject before the verb: 'I don't buy it.' 'Me' is the object after a verb or preposition: 'It beats me', 'Excuse me'. 'My' shows possession before a noun: 'my style', 'my life'.
